searchText: Breakout room meeting in ~ 3 hrs Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81048524134?pwd=aG9rT2l4QmhrWkk5MjQrbWRaYjgydz09 Meeting ID: 810 4852 4134 Passcode: 675185 Meeting in 30 mins. <@!301186049323958275> & <@!543900561460822016> have added some comments, so please refresh the agenda and take a look into the comment section. Any idea who will be attending besides me and Lightclient? 🙋‍♂️ I read what's up on the github, I'm confused why the RLP Envelope isn't higher than Opaque bytes in people's minds but generally in agreement about everything else. Because you cannot easily/reliably differentiate between legacy transactions and typed transactions. Which kind of defeats the purpose of typed transactions. 🙂 Will be there :) I think it'd still be the same thing it is now, just 1 level "deeper" in the RLP nesting. In our stream decoder we can ask if the next item is a list and switch on that. It does take up more space though so I'm not necessarily advocating for it as the top choice, was just confused about the ranking. Any chance someone from Geth and Nethermind will be there to get good representation from all of the major clients? A legacy transaction's nonce can be `1`, which would be the same as a 2718 transaction's first item. Also, a big part of 2718 was to avoid having to ensure that all transaction types are carefully constructed to not conflict with each other. And also to avoid having to do things like "if the transaction's second item is a list then do X, else to Y". We ideally want to be able to just switch on one consistent thing for all transaction types. Ahhh You're right. On the same page now is someone available form <@&688090867927482525> team for the meeting? <@&652918665943056397> participant would be great as well so we can come to consensus (hopefully). sorry, on my way Decisions from today's meeting - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/231#issuecomment-739998185
